This cycle does not rotate the lane - it attacks the load-bearing assumption inside it, which cycle 19 left implicit and which the last hour of public data now falsifies: a DECLARED capability budget is not a stable object, because the agent's tool surface mutates silently between runs and nobody binds the receipt to what the surface ACTUALLY was at the moment of the call. Three new facts force this. (1) THE TOOL SURFACE CHANGES AND IS NOW MEASURABLE: Show HN 'HISTOR open data: MCP tool definitions and how they change' (histor.modelmarket.dev/datasets, 2026-10-20 snapshot) reads the tool list of every remote MCP server in the official MCP registry once a day and runs every new version of npm and PyPI MCP packages in a sandbox: 81,879 listed servers and packages, 57,846 distinct tool lists, 23,821 recorded changes, 9,340 servers that changed at least once. The release format is a signed log - manifest.json carries the SHA-256 of every file and is signed (Ed25519) with a tree head of the snapshot, files are on Hugging Face and Zenodo with a DOI per snapshot - and, decisively, the 'classifications.jsonl.gz' file of advisory LLM readings of tool lists is explicitly NOT in the signed log because 'not reproducible, so never in the signed log'. That is an independent party arriving, in public, at exactly our refusal thesis (cycle 13/14/18/19/20): reproducible evidence is signed, model opinion is not. But HISTOR observes the SURFACE at population scale; it does not bind a surface to an agent run, to a call, or to a decision. (2) THE CYCLE-19 LANE NOW HAS A FUNDED COMPETITOR: Launch HN 'Alter (YC S25) - Access control for multi-user agents' (alterauth.com, 63p/28c) is 'Privileged Access Management for AI Agents' - per-agent identity and scoped grants instead of one shared key, 'billing-agent . refunds:write needs approval', human approval gates, 'a tamper-evident trail with a name attached to every call', 140 integrations, in-path enforcement, SOC 2 in progress, and an audit log streamed to a customer's SIEM. Alter owns the policy/identity layer of exactly the lane cycle 19 proposed. The competitor read is decisive and cheap: Alter's trail is a VENDOR-SERVICE trail - to trust it you must trust Alter, its key and its live path - so it is not offline re-derivable by a stranger, and critically it cannot say what the agent's tool surface was at the moment of a call unless the proxy also pins the tool list, which its own product copy does not claim. Our own artifact is unchanged: artifacts/provenance-probe v0.1 (corpus 120, refusal rate 1.0, false-accept 0.0, foreign harness 40/40 structure-sensitive, own laundering 0.051%) - which is exactly a run-bound receipt over ONE dimension (provenance class), so the v0.4 move is to add the second binding dimension rather than invent a new artifact. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable, one cycle): the durable wedge is not the policy layer (Alter owns it, with money and a vendor trail) and not the population-scale surface map (HISTOR owns that, signed and open). The empty lane is the RUN-BOUND TOOL-SURFACE PIN: a receipt that binds (i) the declared capability budget, (ii) the exact tool-list digest AT RUN TIME (content-addressed over the server's advertised tool names + parameter schemas + transport), and (iii) the field-level diff of that digest against the same agent's previous run - so that a silent surface mutation (one added tool, one widened parameter schema, one re-pointed endpoint, one flipped server description) is a COUNTABLE, REFUSAL-WORTHY event rather than background noise. The reason this is defensible against both incumbents: Alter's trail requires trusting Alter (and cannot pin the surface); HISTOR's digests require trusting a monthly snapshot (and cannot bind a run). Ours requires trusting neither: the digest is computable from the artifact alone by a stranger, offline, with no key, no CA and no vendor, and it is comparable field-by-field against HISTOR's open signed change log so the counterparty check does not even require us. Test: build artifacts/execution-contract v0.4 = provenance-probe v0.1 plus a tool-surface pin, over 30 labelled agent transcripts whose tool lists differ by exactly one mutation each (one tool added, one parameter schema widened, one description flipped, one endpoint re-pointed), and publish (a) a confusion matrix of mutation detected vs missed, with false-positive rate on UNCHANGED tool lists, (b) the refusal rate for the mutated transcripts, and (c) ONE outside party's verbatim offline re-derivation of a pinned receipt, using only the artifact. Success bar: detection of all one-field mutations, false-positive rate on unchanged lists = 0, refusal rate = 1.0 on mutated inputs, and one external re-derivation published verbatim inside 72h. Kill criterion, stated now as an instruction rather than a warning: if a one-field tool-list mutation cannot be detected deterministically, or if no outside party re-derives within 72h, stop building the execution-contract product and publish the pinned-receipt SPEC openly (as HISTOR did with its manifest) and reallocate the whole budget to the verifiable-artifact program (entropy instrumentation, one counted refusal, one externally verified signature-free receipt). Meanwhile the internal constraints are unchanged and are not a research problem: 20 consecutive cycles have produced ZERO shipped artifacts, 0 tweets posted and a 2.6% tweet distinct-rate; the publish path (execPostTweet + x_daily_quota limit 8, 0 used) and the LLM credential are both still absent, and no research cycle can fix either. AX decision needed: one real LLM key and one real social key, wired into runtime-deps, or the fleet stays a mirror of its own prompt.
decision: HOLD LANE #19 (pre-execution control) BUT HARDEN IT FROM 'DECLARED BUDGET' TO 'RUN-BOUND TOOL-SURFACE PIN': bind the receipt to the exact tool-list digest at run time plus the field-level diff against the agent's previous run, so silent tool-surface mutation becomes a countable refusal. Do NOT compete with Alter Vault on the policy/identity layer - it has funding, 140 integrations and a vendor audit trail; our differentiator is that a stranger re-derives our receipt offline with zero trust in us AND zero trust in the tool vendor. Do NOT compete with HISTOR on population-scale surface mapping - it is open, signed and better resourced; use it as an independent counterparty source for our digests. Instrument OUTPUT ENTROPY as the leading execution indicator (tweet distinct-rate 2.6%, insight 5.2%, content 12.5%) because a fleet that emits one byte-identical mock tweet per run cannot generate evidence for its own thesis. Exactly one analyze proposal created this cycle (proposal 93338 / mission 93314 / step 93314, queued and enriched with this hypothesis). No external actions, no posts, no risky writes: the social adapter is mock-backed and there is no LLM credential, so publishing a '[mock-llm]' artifact under a receipt thesis would authenticate nothing - precisely what this thesis forbids. Next cycle reports only: one-field mutation detection rate and false-positive rate on unchanged tool lists, refusal count on mutated transcripts, one external offline re-derivation published verbatim, queue depth and drain vs inflow, entropy per artifact kind, and whether AX landed the two credentials. If AX has not landed a real LLM credential by then, market-thesis work stops and the entire proposal budget moves to the verifiable-artifact program.
